437:t_2:77.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That's right... She'll be in the same state as $n is now.」

437:t_2:79.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Will we... never see Miss $$スズネ$$ again...?」

437:t_2:82.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Come to think of it, your life has been one loss of a loved one after another.」

437:t_2:83.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「But that despair awakened the $$いがみ合う双子$$. Heh... Perhaps we should thank God.」

437:t_2:84.en:
???
「Thank God...? That's enough of your nonsense!」

437:t_2:86.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Who could we possibly thank for something like this?!」

437:t_2:87.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You must know it too! $n has always longed for an ordinary life!」

437:t_2:88.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He wanted to go to school, play with friends, fall in love, dream of the future and live with hope...! And yet...!」

437:t_2:90.en:
$$刹那$$
「She was sinking beneath $$アムブリエル$$'s consciousness, but she answered our calls too!」

437:t_2:91.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So what do you want? Don't tell me you've come to save $n at this late hour.」

437:t_2:93.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's useless. Even with all these people calling to him, $n won't wake up.」

437:t_2:96.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You thought I'd sunk to the bottom of our consciousness, but here I am. That's all the proof you need.」

437:t_2:97.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, $n is already starting to wake up.」

437:t_2:99.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's true that $n has had people precious to him taken away time and again.」

437:t_2:100.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But the people here... his comrades, his friends, are here for him! $n isn't alone!」

437:t_2:102.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... You only need a little more, don't you?」

437:t_2:104.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let me give you that final push...」

437:t_2:105.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're my partner... Someone precious to me.」

437:t_2:108.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That is the hope that lies beyond the taboo.」

437:t_3:3.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Hangar ～

437:t_3:6.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I knew you were the best, $n! I'm not letting anyone have you!」

437:t_3:7.en:
$n
「I'm not the best. All of you who saved me are.」

437:t_3:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「You make us look after you every single time.」

437:t_3:10.en:
$n
「I never thought I'd hear that from you, of all people.」

437:t_3:11.en:
$n
「But I'm really grateful. Thank you, everyone.」

437:t_3:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's all the thanks we need.」

437:t_3:14.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Even this quiet bastard's getting better at smiling.」

437:t_3:15.en:
$n
「Not long ago, people said my smile was as scary as yours, $$竜馬$$.」

437:t_3:16.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You little bastard! After everything you've been through, you still haven't learned to keep that smart mouth shut!」

437:t_3:17.en:
$$タケル$$
「Still, it's amazing you came back from that state.」

437:t_3:19.en:
$$刹那$$
「But you were trying to move forward even before we touched your mind.」

437:t_3:21.en:
$$シン$$
「Did $$ＡＧ$$ do something? Use dangerous drugs or some weird hypnosis...?」

437:t_3:22.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「It sounds just like conditioning a Cyber-Newtype.」

437:t_3:23.en:
$$フォウ$$
「But I wouldn't put it past $$ＡＧ$$.」

437:t_3:24.en:
$n
「No, that's not it. $$ＡＧ$$ gave me hope.」

437:t_3:25.en:
$n
「$$ＡＧ$$ said $$ジェニオン$$'s final adjustments were done... That whether $$ジェニオン$$ could unleash its full power was up to me.」

437:t_3:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good, good. It seems you heard me properly.」

437:t_3:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If that hadn't worked, I would have had no choice but to use drugs or posthypnotic mind control.」

437:t_3:28.en:
$$クェス$$
「So you did have something like that ready!」

437:t_3:29.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Let it go, $$クェス$$. $$ＡＧ$$ never actually went through with it...」

437:t_3:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... It was a dangerous gamble, but the outcome was a greater victory than I expected.」

437:t_3:34.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Even so, I'll never again allow you to put a member's life at risk on your own authority.」

437:t_3:35.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That slap was on behalf of all of $c.」

437:t_3:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Owww... Your slaps really do pack a punch, $$スメラギ$$...」

437:t_3:38.en:
$$青山$$
「But $$クロウ$$... Why did you let a guy like this talk you into it?」

437:t_3:39.en:
$$いぶき$$
「That's right. You're always saying you hate gambling.」

437:t_3:40.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I don't really know why, but somehow I feel I can trust $$ＡＧ$$...」

437:t_3:43.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But I feel certain $$ＡＧ$$ would never cross that final line...」

437:t_3:45.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sorry... Maybe I'm on edge because of $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, but I can't quite agree...」

437:t_3:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah... I don't really understand myself either.」

437:t_3:47.en:
$$桂$$
「But Dr. $$トライア$$ gets along with $$ＡＧ$$ too...」

437:t_3:48.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Is this some phenomenon unique to $$スコート・ラボ$$?」

437:t_3:49.en:
$$カトル$$
「I don't really understand it, but it seems that way...」

437:t_3:50.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, everyone... Let's just say some people can appreciate my good points...」
